subject: Converting hemibrain neuron meshes to other template brain spaces

messages.author: 1100dde5b99c8951
messages.subject: Converting hemibrain neuron meshes to other template brain spaces
parts:
Hello all,

Previously we have used something like:

hemibrain_neurons.jrc2018f = xform_brain(hemibrain_neurons*8/1000, reference = "JRC2018F", sample = "JRCFIB2018F")

to convert neurons downloaded w/ neuprint_read_neurons() function.

however, this conversion does not seem to yield reasonable values when using hemibrain_neuron_meshes() function. wondering if anyone has run into this or has a workaround? I suspect the problem lies in the triangular meshes applied when downloading the neurons but the neuron objects that result from hemibrain_neuron_meshes() are a bit harder to interpret.

messages.author: 7f0257cd1389289f
messages.subject: Re: [nat-user] Converting hemibrain neuron meshes to other template brain spaces
parts:
Dear Pasha, I forget for sure but I think the neuron meshes are calibrated in nm not voxels, so just divide by 1000 without the extra factor of 8 and things should behave. I best, Greg. 

Sent from my iPhone
